notes.title: Under a Desert Sun Beta 0.75
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Like before I've not been able to work on the SP map so no updates on that for now. Instead I've opted to add more functionality and other small bits in this update with the biggest addition being several new enemies and enemy types.

[b]New monsters & Boss fights[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/619f84ed2baa83ffa31871625c8ce8bc747b9af1.png[/img]
I've added several new monsters to all wavemaps. Some will randomly spawn and others will visit you on the third round as boss fights. The bosses are obviously quite hard to kill. Let me know what you think in the comments!

[b]New starting area[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/3fb6c349441fd2ff9544d75ea45949078d47ac34.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/23bcbc1671fda7f46372033256efcd756312da44.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/dd9bc57ed4a03e1840e25597013c4b84e9ed0609.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/e3e461b741a4fff75a058087bc03369445ce8715.png[/img]
I've created the final starting area. Previously I used maps I worked on as temporary starting areas. This starting area is the final an true starting area of the game. And yes, it's an airship with your own personal plane and dog. Epic? Yes. 

[b]New rifle - M1 Carbine[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/ac69d27b5508ff3ac78ae425c6db931ac81f8bdf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/58ae4ab8cbb53be310422ed90a28b5bfdf24b597.png[/img]
The M1 Carbine was a weapon I just did not want to miss in Under a Desert Sun. I've added it to the game. Let me know how you think it handles and if it still needs tweaking.


[b]Small changes[/b]
I've also changed some small things

[u]Spring clips[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/6f4dd0e8314b73feddf75b196bb1d6b705d6313a.gif[/img]
Many guns now have spring clips so the ammo releases better and does not reslot accidentally. It also looks kinda cool.

[u]Lvl cubes[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/ef324c629b7f87f282ad3dfb9e1c2e4870854502.gif[/img]
Lvl cubes in the lobby no longer get lost. They always return to the spot you found them if you drop them.

[u]More room in some maps[/u]
I found that the desert maps especially had non logical boundries. I've made sure that there is a bit more room to move and that the desert dunes have become the logical cutoff.

[u]Default grabbing method = grab[/u]
As some of you know, this game started out as a game just for the vive loooong ago. So toggle grabbing was the default method. I've noticed that this is annoying for most users these days. There always was an option for just grabbing when you hold the grab button. I've set this to default for new players.[u] The option for toggle grabbing still remains in the options menu![/u]

[b]Some small things I am still working on:[/b]
- The armor of most enemies can be shot off. However there's still some tweaking to be done here.
- I want to make the flamethrower boss his gastanks to be explodable in a way that shooting the top of the gastank makes them go BOOMMMMMM!
- I feel the big hulk monster still needs something extra, if you have any ideas, let me know in the comments!

[b]Known bugs[/b]
I've noticed that the sand fading of enemies sometimes triggers in the newest desert map. Looking into this and how to fix. Will fix it with a small patch and mention it in the comments.

Hope you like it!

Kind regards,
Raymond

notes.title: Final Alpha update
notes.content:
Hi there,

I am very happy to announce that this is the last alpha post. This means that after this update Under a Desert Sun will enter beta phase. Just to recap:

[b]For Under a Desert Sun I try and work in 3 main phases:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Alpha phase, in this I create functionality and test it by implementing it in wavemaps or test maps. The wave maps will stay as a separate mode when the game is finished next to the singleplayer
[*] Beta phase, will focus on creating the singleplayer and narrative
[*] Pollish phase, an extensive bug fix and pollish period where we make sure everything works optimally and performance is improved as much as possible.
[/olist]

[b]In this post I want to do two things, [/b]
[olist]
[*] Mention the changes in this particular patch
[*] Recap all the things that are now available in beta
[/olist]

[b]Changes and additions In this last alpha update[/b]
[u]Updated weapon behaviour[/u]
[list]
[*] Colt1911 is now manual reload
[*] Improved manual reload on most weapons
[*] Fixed Colt, Luger and Bar ammo clip drop bug. They would pop trough gun geometry sometimes.
[*] Fixed bolting bug where you can pull bolt further then it should go. 
[/list]
[u]Updated the tutorial level[/u]
[list]
[*] All tutorials have new movies that better depict how the current guns work
[*] Added tutorial text and movies on enemy stagger and melee weapons
[/list]
[u]Flight mechanics[/u]
[list]
[*] Guns for player and enemies now work
[*] You can dogfight enemies, enemies respawn after being destroyed
[*] Hands animate when grabbing stick and throttle
[/list]

[b]Alpha recap[/b]
The alpha phase is there so I can make and test many mechanics that I will use in the singleplayer. Basically I've worked on an entire “adventure game” template which I can now use to make the singleplayer. You, the player, have helped me enormously by testing these mechanics in the wave maps and test maps available in the current early access.

[u]Game mechanics[/u]
I’ve made a whole bunch of standard game mechanics ready to be used in game. These are things such as:
[list]
[*] Health indicators
[*] Hit behaviour
[*] Highlighters for dynamic objects
[*] Animation and sound behaviours
[*] Sound, Particle and animation triggers
[*] Level switch triggers
[*] Menu settings
[*] Physics and collision behaviour for movement and hands
[/list]

[u]Weapons[/u]
I’ve implemented fully controllable melee and projectile weapons.
All weapons can be controlled by your VR controllers

[/list]


[u]Enemies[/u]

The range of things is quite broad but basically I have all the necessary things to make a first singleplayer chapter from desert environments to rainy city scapes with a 1940’s vibe.

I am sure I didn't mention everything I did in the last three years but I hope this gives an idea of the scope of the entire alpha. Personally I am quite happy what I have achieved so far as a lone developer doing this next to his full time job ;) And now we go onward towards the beta! Will post soon when I've got some things to show.

Be safe everyone and kind regards,
Raymond

notes.title: Under a Desert Sun Alpha 0.99999
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As you know I have started adding graphic settings to the menu. I've finalized this with this update adding the following to the settings:

[list]
[*] Resolution scale, effects sharpness
[*] Anti Aliasing, effects border sharpness
[*] Texture quality, the resolution and sharpness of the textures
[*] Bloom, post processing effect to add a haze around lighting and glimmer
[*] Ambient occlusion, post processing effect to add small shadows in corners and closely spaced objects
[/list]

I would appreciate it if any comments, ideas and bugs would be mentioned to me on my discord channel for the game instead. Trust me, I am listening and always answer any questions and reports. see the link below in this update text.


[b]Realistic hand behaviour[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/d95280f118bc882c3a3e2dde53e6bf098aec303e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/3b6bf267f84430c012c78d771a69949265925d2d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/6b85f4c7b64d3630e9b78dbf01d9673a28ffe19b.gif[/img]
I wanted the hands to not move through objects anymore. As most big VR games have this feature and it’s really becoming the norm I wanted to make sure Under a Desert Sun does not lag behind on this aspect. I’ve implemented an early version of hand collision that in my opinion works quite nicely. It does the following:
[list]
[*] Hands do not move through objects anymore
[*] If you push your hands through a wall or an object the hand stays somewhere close to the entry point of the wall
[*] You can still move your hand along the wall
[*] Your fingers move in accordance to the wall, this is quite neat, the vingers bend a bit with your hand, just like in real life! It doesn’t work perfectly because that would cost too much performance but the illusion works well enough. I Think it adds to the immersion.
[*] When holding a weapon your hands still can’t go through the wall and when a weapon sticks out too far into an object it will turn and make sure it does not go through the wall, this last bit is not perfect yet, weapons can still stick slightly in a wall. 
[/list]
As a lone developer this is some pretty intense/math stuff so I will keep working on this to perfect it. However, I think for a first attempt in the alpha this works quite well already.

[b]Flying[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/8176ac07e37717647f5c1a138a12303aa72b7136.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/84446a4bc365c2803f8554b1f529dee43dddba88.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Added working throttle and airspeed Gauges
[*] Added artificial horizon, now you always know when you’re upside down
[*] Added airplane targeter, it points towards a target, handy!
[*] Added more enemies with more complex follow behavior(The enemies no longer crash into you and try to shoot you while getting behind you)
[/list]
Please keep in mind that I am still working on bullets and shooting, even though the enemies try to shoot you and you can shoot, you won’t be able to hit anything yet ;) As I said, very alpha and only released so people can test things as early as possible.

[b]Small stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] I added a fade to black before a level is loaded. This is much easier on the eyes as the normal level loading behaviour was a bit jittery.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The mummy-like enemies no longer faded away after death, This is now fixed, dust everywhere!
[*] You no longer hang still midair when stopping movement on stairs, instead gravity does its work properly now
[/list]

You'll also notice that you get access to a few more areas to get a feel for what the final games style is going to be. Furthermore there are a lot of improvements and fixes. I will make sure that a trailer update will be made since this update really changes the feel of the entire game..for the better in my opinion and hopefully yours! 

[b]Goal[/b]
Goals for this update are.

[b]Make Under a Desert Sun ready for:[/b]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer use
[*] Areas in sync with vibe/style of the game
[*] More user-friendly and entertaining starting area, no more huge portals instead I made a neat level picker system that makes sure we can add more and more levels without having to create huge portals. You can simply use level cube’s to play a level.
[*] Allow access to more of the singleplayer area’s. Keep in mind these are work in progress
[*] Test and verify Oculus headsets works. They work! So are now supported with Under a Desert Sun.
[/list]

[b]Oculus support[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/fb5e3c1872edd66c282fd13467707c00864b52fe.png[/img]
As mentioned above, the game will from now on support the Oculus headsets. 

[b]New areas to explore[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/314797778f272eff147c621105722d23fda26820.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/0412e3846ce06acc2bdf60630132948778749932.gif[/img]

The starting room and a Tutorial level are new! I’ve also added a work in progress map of the city at night. You can now enter levels by placing level cubes on the pedestal in the starting area. Can you find al the level cube’s to see what’s being worked on? I’ve hidden them in the level. More new areas are coming very soon including a new wave level. Most levels have also been updated go see what’s changed!

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[u]Reduces holsters from three to two. [/u]
I found the middle holster mostly annoying. I have reduced the holster number to just two. The hip-ammo holster and a holster on your other hip. This way you can carry a max of two weapons.

[u]Changed way leaderboard updates[/u]
The leaderboard will always upload your score. Previously you had to fight until death to get a score upload.

[u]Wave level changes[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/41bb2ecc0ff278be528858735e5fc25d248c82cb.gif[/img]
The wave levels can now be accessed using the level picker cubes. I've also added weapons stashes to each map. You no longer need to bring a weapon to the level, you'll be able to pick one at the start of the level. I've also hidden some “special” weapons throughout each wave map.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/5d612b8b8312b5bc2054e7e57310fabb58f96b53.gif[/img]
Lots of lighting fixes in all maps
Tremendous improvement in collision detection using trackpad movement. No more jitters.
Fixed highlighting bugs on the bolt of several weapons
Fixed some small damage bugs on enemies, sometimes they would not get hit.

[b]Upcoming[/b]
[u]City level [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/1bf06cb751ac0dbefbc682a364a564a48b634962.gif[/img]
as promised I will soon release a new wavemap (This map wil lateron be used in the singleplayer.

[u]Climbing mechanics[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/28df69a15d430d074cb6c2bec6d04188def89ac9.gif[/img]
To make levels more vertical I'll add climbing, you can see a work in progress here.

Discord
We have an active discord channel. Any feedback is greatly appreciated! The discord: https://discord.gg/g5fK7Df

Roadmap

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1332591824

I've worked on some improved death animations that make the transition for dead characters look more natural..well..magical really..

The point is that characters don't just disapear anymore instead they have a more logical transition.

Furthermore i've been trying to bugfix some bugs concerning the weapon holsers and holding items. It would in some cases happen that you'd be able to hold more then one item at a time. Or worse hold two guns in the
same hand. I've been able to resolve this somewhat. However, I suspect that there are specific cases where this might still be the case. It would help a bunch if players could mention these cases. It would make the search easier.

I know many are looking forward to the alpha puzzlemap. I'm really trying to get it at a stage where it's fun to test. But, we're not there yet. I will keep everyone posted.

Lastly, I know many people feel the controls can be improved. I am looking into this. A small example is that the menu now can be used by using both the grab and trigger button. I'm experimenting with doing this in more places such as the grabbable objects.

Kind regards,
Ray

notes.title: Under a Desert Sun update - alpha 0.501
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=943033181
I've just released an update on the new alpha 0.5. This update contains a new module for touchpad movement. As previously mentioned this module is build up from the ground by myself, giving me more control, and less bugs because of external libraries and such. Bleh tech talk! :P

Thing's you might notice:
- The movement is no longer connected to your look direction. I found this anoying and counter intiuitive when strafing. You now simply move towards the direction you are pointing at on the touchpad.

- You can walk really slow, fast or anything in between, the new module made it easier to make sure you can move slowly. Also i've upped the walking speed slightly.

- The collisions are a bit jittery, this is the one big downside of my own model, which I am sure i'll fix in the future. 

In addition to the new touchpad movement i've fixed:
- zombie helmets floating in the air when shot (As you can see in the gif above),
- stg44 ammo was backwards when you grab it,
- small code stuff you probably didn't notice ;)

in the next update i will continue with ironing out some bugs among which:
- the bow arrows work badly on living enemies,
- sometimes grabbing a new weapon from the table glitches and suddenly you're holding two weapons in the same hand,
- when holding a weapon in both hands the controllers re-apear.
- the new airfield level is not pointermovement-proof, if you do your best you can get into places you aren't supposed to be.

Don't hesitate to post more bugs, it's one of the main reasons we're in early access after all!

Kind regards,
Ray

notes.title: Update alpha 0.5 - New enemies, a new map and a new gun!
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=938047662

As you might have noticed the speed with which I bring new updates hase been slightly lower than usual. The main reason is that i've been working on some pretty big things for this release. 

With this update some of the larger elements will be introduced. Namely:
- Living nazi enemies! This update introduced the first version of living enemies. There's allot to still work on but these enemies are capable of shooting back and making things though for you in all sorts of new ways.They form the basis of all living enemies in the future technologywise.

- A new map, with the new enemies I wanted to make an environment that suits the enemies. Also, the singleplayer game will have a part of the story happen on an enemy desert airbase. 

- Lastly a new weapon. This update introduces the STG44 to the game. Go try it  out it's on the table!

Improvements and fixes
- The night and day map of the village have better textures
- Tweaks on several weapons
- Toned down the ragdolling effect so enemies fly around less
- Made sure that enemy helmets can be shot of the head with a satisfying PINGGGGGG :D

Promised but not yet implemented (Pushed to alpha 0.501)
I've also pushed some features from this release. The main reason was that I wanted to focus on getting the features in this release as stable as possible. This took more time then expected. These features are:
- Voice acting test technology, triggers and such that start voice acting
- Puzzle test technology, a map and technology for physics puzzles and such

As always try the tutorial if you are new! And don't forget that you can take any weapon you want with you into a portal as long as you hold it in your hand!

notes.title: Update alpha 0.403 - Tweaks and a new inventory slot!
notes.content:
This is the second update with tweaks on alpha 0.4. In this update i've mainly focused on the inventory system. The most important addition is a new third inventory that allows you to hold two guns. In the challange maps you now always have a handgun and any additional gun you brought from the main loby. In other words you can now bring a shotgun and grab your handgun if you run empty!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=914641567

Other tweaks and improvements:
- More code simplification and cleanup. 
- Inventory weapons can now swap. In other words if you hold a gun and want to grab another, the held gun is swapped with the one in the inventory slot.
- Ammo Immediatly changes when grabbing a gun. This was needed because you can now swap guns on the fly having two inventory slots
- Picking up the bow from the table and taking it into the portal works, before  this was the only weapon that you could not take with you.
- All interactions are now left/right independend, in other both controllers work in every situation. Only difference between left and right are the movement button layout.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a small bug where multiple weapons would be spawned on the table
- Fixed the shotgun shells being placed in your hand backwards
Upcoming:
For alpha 0.5 i'm looking into the following:
- New enemies
- New maps
- Puzzle behaviour
- Triggered voiceacting events

Singleplayer:
Just to remind everyone, every bit of functionality that's made right now is in service of the single player that I will start building once the technical building blocks are there. The functionality made so far and that will be made for alpha 0.5 will all be seen again in the singleplayer campain.

As always check the tutorial on the right if this is your first time!

notes.title: Update alpha 0.401 - Tweaks and burning arrows!!
notes.content:
As I mentioned in the dev diary on the UDS youtube channel I wanted to do some small tweaks before I start on the true 0.5 work. It turns out this was really needed because i've been able to make a slew of small improvements. 

As I also mention in the dev diary I tried to listen to your remarks and desires concerning the game. In a small twitter questionere I asked if there are any types of weapons people would still like to have. Most people wanted burning arrows, something that was also mentioned on reddit allot. Well..this patch contains just that!

[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910265356] Burning arrows![/URL]

For now you can still find the bow on the well in both challange maps. Pretty soon i'll make sure that you can simply grab it from the table and take it with you!

Tweaks and improvements:
- Overal code simplification. 

- You now only feel the upper inventories buzz when you hold the bow. Otherwise these inventory slots are not used, so there was no need for buzzing. 

- Both controllers work in any of the inventories. Before there was a mandatory left or right controller for the inventory. This was anoying because you could, for example, not grab ammo with your right controller. I've made the inventories "controller side independent". So now you can grab your gun using either controler and grab ammo using either controller. This allows me to soon add a new inventory slot for handguns at the chest area!

- Improved the grip sound of the shotgun

- Fixed a small bug where sometimes the shells of the shotgun would not eject properly

Upcoming:
Keep an eye out on the forums and this board to get an idea of alpha 0.5 soon!!

As always please try the tutorial on the right to get an idea of the current controls. Also use the portals to start a map!

notes.title: Update alpha 0.307
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Welcome to the latest update of UDS. In addition to the new start screen, the new challange map and lots of new guns, I've added an alternative button mapping options. One option allows you to grab items by simply holding the controller close to the inventory and ofcourse there is an option using the grab button as requested. 

I've found that in particular the " on collision" option work very well for the bow as well as the guns. In addition I added some force feedback to the inventory so you always know when your hand is near it. This helps being able to grab ammo and guns without having to look where your hand is.
By default the thumb option is still set. Try changing the option in the menu to test it out! I'd love to hear what everyone thinks so shoutout on the forums!

As previously mentioned this update contains the biggest addition to UDS yet, therefore I will up the price of the game. I've chosen to up it with 2 dollars bringing the full price to 3 dollars or the equivelant of this in your own currency. There will not be any further price changes untill alpha 0.5 as this price incorporates the guns, movement mechanic

Welcome to the latest update of UDS. In addition to the new start screen i've added a new version of the current wave map. This map uses the Thompson machine gun and has vastly more difficult mummies for you to tackle. To make things even harder, there's a sandstorm going on so good luck!

This new map tests several things. Obviously the machine gun behaviour. But the sound and visuall effects of sandstorms are also in there for testing purposes. I'd love to hear what everyone thinks so shoutout on the forums!
This map and these guns are the biggest addition to UDS yet. And as mentioned previously I will up the price of the game. I've chosen to up it with 2 dollars bringing the full price to 3 dollars or the equivelant of this in your own currency. 

There will not be any further price changes untill alpha 0.5 as this price incorporates the guns, movement mechanic changes and other improvements I still intend to make for version alpha 0.4.

In the comming weeks i'll still keep adding more guns. I've also not forgotten about:
-  Alternate button layout options
- Improved hit behaviour (Sound and visuals) 
Bugfixes in this build:
- Fixed a nasty sound bug causing the gun to sometimes not make sounds

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.302:
notes.content:
Update Alpha 0.302:
Hi everyone,

In this update the first elements of alpha 0.4 will come in to place. On the table in the start area and in the main map there's a new gun to play around with. The colt 1911. It replaces the C69 which I used for the test setup. You'll notice that this gun actually animates and uses actual ammo in stead of a weird little block ;)

For the gun-nuts, jep the magazine has 5 bullets more than the maximum capacity in this time period. It was actually 8 to 10. But hey..I can't let you guys go up against mummies with just 10 bullets..So I made it 15.

The overal idea of these new guns is that these are the actual guns you'll be using in the final game. They will look, feel and act more polished. I hope this first update gives an idea of what this will look like. 

I also hope everyone is looking forward to the new guns, if you have ideas, don't hesitate to post them!

In the coming weeks i'll start adding more guns. I'll also add:
- Alternate button layout options
- As there are more guns there will be different challange maps
- Improved hit behaviour (Sound and visuals when you get hit)

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.3:
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Welcome to the current build of UDS. I'm proud to announce that this is the promised alpha 0.3 release. This build contains in addition to the original setup:

- Trackpad movement
- Improved wave mechanics
- Steam leaderboard integration

To me this is the setup that shows what fun can be had in this setting and with the current game mechanics. I feel this build also adds the competativeness I was looking for in the test set up.

Bugfixes and improvements:
- I've made small controll changes. You now can press anywhere on the thumbpad to grab things from the inventory. (The big alternate button layout options will be in 0.4).

Things still to come for version 0.4:
- Alternate button layout options
- New guns(Anyone like the idea of shooting mummies with a shotgun ;)?)
- Improved hit behaviour (Sound and visually)

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Time for a first update. Feedback has been dripping in since the release and I’ve taken the time to address some small issues and added some small improvements. As mentioned on the forums. I will be working on release alpha 0.3, but bugfixes have priority as I want this build to become stable for everyone to play.

This update contains:
Bugfixes: 
You could pick up the ground! This will go into history as the most “earth shattering” bug ever ;)!

You no longer are able to grab the gun from the inventory when the controller is not close to the inventory “ bowl”.

Improvements:
Bow: you now have to grab arrows from your back using thumbpad-up! Makes bow use quite a bit harder so I am considering upping the damage of arrows.

Menu, has a nice small animation now, will improve further.

notes.title: Here we go!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With this very first announcement I’d like to focus on the soon to be release Early Acces of Under a Desert Sun. A game that, once finished, will be a story driven VR shooter with full motion control and a fun adventure to be had in a Mummy and Nazi invested desert.
We’re not there yet of course and this is early access after all. 

During development we’ll go through 3 main phases:
-Building game mechanics
-Story writing
-Building the story game with the game mechanics

So if you decide to buy this game now, what you’ll get is a small Proof of concept setup which I am using to verify game mechanics. The proof of concept basically is a wave based shooter. I intend to add new things to this setup over time. These things can vary from, new movement options or new sounds to new sets of weapons.
For those who are along for the ride, feel free to post on the forums what you think, find and would think is cool to add!

Lastly a shoutout to some people who've been a great help during the preparation phase:
- Thomas (Containment initiative, awesome game you guys should play it), had so much help and support awesome!
- Darrel, super tester!
- Vasanth Mohan(Fusemen), awesome tutorials and help on VR+Unity development, check them out on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLO98KHpNx6JwsdnH04l9yQ

Thanks so much for the support and help so far!
